name: Exp_XOSignal_ReOpen
summary: This EA trades based on XOSignal (Point & Figure) indicator signals and implements a ReOpen mechanism that adds to existing positions when the signal persists. It opens buy positions on X (cross) signals and sell positions on O (circle) signals from the Point & Figure chart, with the ability to re-enter or add positions on subsequent confirmations.
summary_zh: 该EA基于XOSignal（点数图）指标信号进行交易，并实现了重新开仓机制，当信号持续时可在现有仓位上加仓。在点数图的X（十字）信号时开多仓，O（圆圈）信号时开空仓，并可在后续确认时重新入场或加仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Point & Figure（点数图/XO图）指标信号，这是一种经典的图表分析方法，通过过滤市场噪音来识别趋势方向。入场条件为：当XOSignal指标产生X信号（看涨突破）时开多仓，产生O信号（看跌突破）时开空仓。ReOpen机制是该EA的特色功能，当趋势信号持续确认时，允许在已有同方向仓位的基础上再次开仓加码，从而在趋势行情中获取更大收益。出场条件主要依赖于反向XOSignal信号的出现，当指标产生反向信号时平掉原有仓位并可能反向开仓。仓位管理方面，EA通过ReOpen参数控制是否允许加仓以及加仓的条件，但具体的仓位大小计算依赖于外部仓位管理模块或固定手数设置。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈参数，但核心的风险控制依赖于XOSignal指标的反转信号，在强趋势中ReOpen机制可能导致持仓过重。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Point & Figure (XO chart) indicator signal, which is a classic chart analysis method that filters market noise to identify trend direction. Entry conditions: open long positions when the XOSignal indicator produces an X signal (bullish breakout), and open short positions when it produces an O signal (bearish breakout). The ReOpen mechanism is the distinctive feature of this EA — when the trend signal continues to confirm, it allows opening additional positions in the same direction on top of existing positions, thereby capturing larger profits during trending markets. Exit conditions primarily rely on the appearance of a reverse XOSignal; when the indicator produces an opposite signal, the existing position is closed and a new position may be opened in the reverse direction. Position sizing is controlled through the ReOpen parameter which governs whether additional entries are permitted and under what conditions, while the actual lot size calculation depends on an external position sizing module or fixed lot settings. Money management provides stop loss and take profit parameters, but the core risk control relies on XOSignal reversal signals, and the ReOpen mechanism may lead to overexposure during strong trends.

parameters.name: ReOpen
parameters.description: 是否允许在已有同方向仓位时重新开仓加码
parameters.description_en: Allow re-entry to add position in same direction

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, limits max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, locks profit target per trade

parameters.name: MoneyManagement
parameters.description: 是否启用资金管理模块自动计算仓位
parameters.description_en: Enable money management for auto lot sizing

parameters.name: RiskPercent
parameters.description: 资金管理模式下的风险百分比
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage under money management mode

parameters.name: XOSignal_BoxSize
parameters.description: 点数图的箱体大小参数
parameters.description_en: Point and figure box size parameter

parameters.name: XOSignal_Reversal
parameters.description_en: Point and figure reversal box count

pros: 基于Point & Figure指标，能有效过滤市场噪音，识别真实趋势突破
ReOpen机制允许在趋势确认后加仓，能在强趋势行情中最大化收益
支持资金管理模块，可根据账户风险自动调整仓位大小
信号逻辑清晰，X信号做多、O信号做空，规则明确无歧义
点数图方法历史悠久且经过长期验证，具有统计学上的可靠性
pros_en: Based on the Point & Figure indicator which effectively filters market noise and identifies genuine trend breakouts
The ReOpen mechanism allows adding positions after trend confirmation, maximizing profits during strong trending markets
Supports a money management module that can automatically adjust position sizing based on account risk
Signal logic is clear and unambiguous — X signal for longs, O signal for shorts with well-defined rules
The Point & Figure method has a long historical track record and statistical reliability
cons: ReOpen加仓机制在趋势反转时可能导致多重亏损，风险集中度过高
止损和止盈默认值为0，如果不手动设置则完全依赖反向信号出场，风险较大
Point & Figure指标参数（箱体大小、反转数）对结果影响极大，参数敏感性高
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
震荡行情中XOSignal可能频繁翻转产生虚假信号，导致连续亏损
cons_en: The ReOpen pyramiding mechanism can lead to multiple layered losses during trend reversals, concentrating risk excessively
Stop loss and take profit default to 0, meaning without manual settings the EA relies entirely on reverse signals for exit, which is risky
Point & Figure indicator parameters (box size, reversal count) have extreme impact on results, making the strategy highly parameter-sensitive
Lacks a new bar check mechanism, potentially opening repeated positions on the same bar
In ranging markets, XOSignal may flip frequently producing false signals that lead to consecutive losses
improvements: 增加最大加仓次数限制和总仓位上限控制，防止ReOpen机制导致过度持仓
添加新K线检查逻辑，避免在同一根K线上重复开仓，并增加点差过滤条件
引入ATR动态止损替代固定点数止损，使止损适应市场波动性
增加趋势过滤条件（如大周期MA方向确认），减少震荡行情中的虚假信号交易
improvements_en: Add a maximum re-open count limit and total position cap to prevent the ReOpen mechanism from causing overexposure
Implement a new bar check to avoid repeated entries on the same bar, and add a spread filter condition
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss instead of fixed pip stops, adapting stop levels to market volatility
Add a trend filter condition (e.g., higher timeframe MA direction confirmation) to reduce false signal trades in ranging markets

risk_points: ReOpen加仓机制可能在趋势反转时导致多层级连续亏损，风险敞口快速放大
默认止损止盈为0，若未手动设置则无硬性风控保护
缺少新K线检查可能在同一K线上重复开仓造成过度交易
risk_points_en: The ReOpen pyramiding mechanism may cause cascading multi-level losses during trend reversals, rapidly amplifying risk exposure
Default stop loss and take profit are zero, providing no hard risk control protection unless manually configured
Lack of new bar check may cause over-trading through repeated entries on the same bar
